description: Straps, cords, tags and laces that hang from the subject swing gently with the clip's one wind. Added when ingest found a hanging part with high confidence, never on a rigged subject or one playing its own clip (the rig or clip already moves its straps).

windCalibration.unit: tip m per m of part per (m/s)^2 (engine/physics/sway.DRAG_K)
